findings.title: The palette role list does not cover the door and effects colours that section 4 says will read roles
findings.claim: Section 4 says 'The tile layer, the door model and the effects read roles instead of their module constants', but the role list only has doorFill and doorOutline for doors and nothing for most effects colours. The door model also has SEALED_FILL, HELD_TICK and SPACE_GAP. effects.ts has the fire fallback orange, the active breach red, the airlock outline cyan, the vent speck pale blue, the failed-station yellow and the IMPACT colour. Section 1 says every procedural stroke is whole art pixels, but the effects airlock outline is a 3-unit stroke at offset -2, and the even-grid test only covers wallPicture and doorPicture.
findings.evidence: spec L22, L58, L60; render/doorModel.ts:L5; render/effects.ts:L70, L79, L94, L103, L116
findings.why: Implementers would differ. One adds new roles, another maps these colours onto the nearest ramp entries, a third leaves the constants. A palette swap (Art-ii) would then only partly recolour the interior, and the 'one palette' goal fails for the effects layer.
findings.fix: Either add roles for the missing colours (sealed, heldTick, spaceGap, breach, airlockOutline, failed), or state which ramp entry each one takes (for example fire fallback = fire[2], vent = vent[1]). Either way, say that no 0x literal stays in tiles.ts, doorModel.ts or effects.ts. Extend the even-grid rule (or its test) to the effects rectangles and strokes, or say explicitly that effects outlines are out of scope for Art-i-a.

prior.note: Section 5's duel adapter gives the hull from d.tactical.systems[CREW_SLOT].hull over the class hull and says fire and vacuum are always off (L78). Section 7 uses hitsCrew, and the duel flash covers the whole interior at half strength (L94-95). The screenshot list now asks for duel normal and alert and sector vacuum (L111). hitsCrew exists at fxModel.ts:L35.
L96 names what each shake and flash replaces and which container each shake moves. L95 makes the flash 2 sim ticks, and L97 says the hitstop does not extend it.
L98 gives the key, the default, a boot read in try/catch, a pure feelScale with its multipliers, no menu, and an F9 dev cycle.

I recomputed the table at L49-54 from the formula at L47 and it matches. Cutter: 0.5, 1/3 < 0.491 so kept, 0.5, 0.6, 0.5. Starter: 0.5 < 0.57 so kept, 0.667, 0.75, 0.6, 0.667. Skiff: 1 at every stage. L47 covers re-centring, rounding so x times stage is whole, the same object going to callouts and projectiles, and the path reset on resize. L56 covers the n=0 case.

The static geometry is now on the grid. PANEL_THICK 12 and BAND 10 put every wallPicture rect on even values (wallModel.ts:L26-30 gives x/y 0, 10 or 22 and w/h 10 or 12). But a sliding door panel's width is continuous: doorPicture computes w = HALF*(1-p) and places the panel at x = T - w (doorModel.ts:L23-24), and the airlock stripes start at r.x+4 (L34). So for any progress strictly between 0 and 1, the panels and stripes have odd or fractional x and w. As written, the test that 'every doorPicture rectangle has even x, y, w and h' (spec L58) either fails or only gets run at rest states, and implementers would choose differently. Fix: quantise the slide, w = 2*round(HALF*(1-p)/2), and test doorPicture over a sweep of progress values.
